# AI Community Intertidal Clean up

Group Questions: Species occurrence: For a selected taxon or group, where and when was it recorded? Make an occurrence or detection-frequency summary, explicitly distinguishing absence from not surveyed and accounting for sampling effort.

# Cleaning Data

## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)
library(stringr)
library(maps)
library(mapdata)
library(mapproj)
library(leaflet)
library(sf)
library(maptiles)
library(tidyterra)
library(tidygeocoder)
library(ggspatial)
```

## Load Data

Read in all of the data

```{r}
master <- read_csv("AI_data/Data/Processed/opihi_master.csv")
algae_review <- read_csv("AI_data/algae_origin_review.csv")
raw <- read_csv("AI_data/Data/Processed/opihi_master.csv",show_col_types = FALSE)
lookup <- read_csv("AI_data/algae_origin_lookup.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  select(taxon_clean, origin_status)

```

```{r}
oahu_sites <- tribble(
  ~place,
  "Diamond Head",
  "Ewa Beach",
  "Kahana Bay",
  "Sand Island, Hawaii",
  "Barbers Point, Hawaii", 
  "Turtle Bay, Hawaii",

oahu_geocoded <- oahu_sites |>

oahu_geocoded

leaflet(oahu_geocoded) |>
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery) |>
  addMarkers(
    lng = ~long, lat = ~lat,   # tidygeocoder always returns 'lat' and 'long'
    label = ~place)            # hover to see place name
```

```{r}
algae <- raw |>
  filter(category == "Algae", island=="Oahu") |>
  left_join(lookup, by = "taxon_clean") |>
  mutate(origin_group = case_when(
    origin_status %in% c("Native", "Native (likely)")             ~ "Native",
    origin_status %in% c("Non-native", "Non-native (invasive)")   ~ "Non-native",
    TRUE ~ "Unresolved"   # cryptogenic, genus-level, turf, unknown groups
  ))



```


```{r}
# ----  TIME SERIES: NATIVE vs NON-NATIVE, ONE GRAPH PER SITE ------------------
site_year <- quad_long |>
  group_by(site_name, year, origin_group) |>
  summarise(n_quadrats = n_distinct(sample_id),
            mean_cover = mean(cover),
            se = sd(cover) / sqrt(n()),
            .groups = "drop")

# Only sites with enough survey years for a line to mean anything
min_years <- 3
sites_to_plot <- site_year |>
  group_by(site_name) |>
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") |>
  filter(n_years >= min_years) |>
  pull(site_name)
sites_to_plot

cols <- c("Native" = "#2ca25f", "Non-native" = "#e34a33")

plot_site <- function(site) {
  site_year |>
    filter(site_name == site) |>
    ggplot(aes(year, mean_cover, color = origin_group)) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_cover - se, 0), ymax = mean_cover + se),
                   alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n_quadrats)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Quadrats", range = c(1.5, 5)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::breaks_pretty()) +
    labs(title = site, x = "Year", y = "Mean % cover per quadrat",
         caption = "Points = survey years; bars = +/- 1 SE; unresolved taxa excluded") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
}

# View a single site (swap the name to change locations)
plot_site("Leahi")

# Save one PNG per site
dir.create("site_timeseries", showWarnings = FALSE)
walk(sites_to_plot, \(s)
  ggsave(file.path("site_timeseries",
                   paste0(str_replace_all(tolower(s), "[^a-z0-9]+", "_"), ".png")),
         plot_site(s), width = 7, height = 4, dpi = 300))

# One-page overview of all selected sites
p_all <- site_year |>
  filter(site_name %in% sites_to_plot) |>
  ggplot(aes(year, mean_cover, color = origin_group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(size = n_quadrats)) +
  facet_wrap(~ site_name, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Mean % cover per quadrat", size = "Quadrats") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
ggsave("site_timeseries/all_sites_overview.png", p_all,
       width = 11, height = 8, dpi = 300)

p_all

```

```{r}
ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = CA_data,
               aes(x = long, y = lat,
                   group = group),
               color = "black") +
  coord_map() +
  theme_void()

region_names <- maps::map("worldHires", plot = FALSE, namesonly = TRUE)
oahu_regions <- grep("Oahu", region_names, value = TRUE)
if (length(oahu_regions) == 0) {
  stop("No 'Oahu' region found in mapdata::worldHires. ",
       "Check: grep('Hawaii', maps::map('worldHires', plot = FALSE, namesonly = TRUE), value = TRUE)")
}
oahu <- maps::map("worldHires", regions = oahu_regions, fill = TRUE,
                  plot = FALSE) |>
  st_as_sf()
if (is.na(st_crs(oahu))) st_crs(oahu) <- 4326
bb <- st_bbox(oahu)
```

Location x year presence/absence/not-surveyed tile map (the core figure)

```{r}
p_tile <- ggplot(state_loc_year, aes(year, fct_rev(factor(location)), fill = state)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(is.na(n_events), "", n_events)), size = 2.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = state_cols, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = NULL,
       title = "Where and when was the taxon recorded?",
       subtitle = "Numbers = survey events; grey = no survey that year") +
  theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

Detection frequency by location, with Wilson CI and effort labels

```{r}
p_loc <- freq_loc |>
  ggplot(aes(freq, fct_reorder(location, freq))) +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("n=", n_events)), nudge_y = 0.3, size = 2.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of survey events with detection", y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal()
```
